title: Competition and Crowd-Out for Brand Keywords in Sponsored Search
authors: Andrey Simonov; Chris Nosko; Justin M. Rao
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Large-scale randomized experiments on Bing (brand ads shown or withheld) with click-share comparisons across experimental conditions; package ships simulated aggregates.
design_notes: suppl_materials/run-file-jan-simulated.R: treatment-control differences by Flight_Code (lm of the difference in click probabilities on brand capital), log-log regressions of competitor effects. No panel adoption timing.
data_provenance_note: README: 'we provide simulated data aggregates'; exposures, clicks, cpcs are simulated values.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); design taken from the OpenAlex abstract, README and code. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
